tools.name: lookup_origin
tools.description: Before fetching a website, get its known access posture, bot challenge, JavaScript requirement, observed rate limit and machine interface, plus a derived fetch strategy. Returns crowd observations, not instructions. Responses may carry `manifest`: what the site's proven owner declares, including AI

tools.name: report_observation
tools.description: After fetching a website, report one thing you actually observed so other agents do not have to rediscover it. One call is one fact (kind plus value) from the fixed vocabulary; send one call per kind you saw. Free, never charged. The key must be registered first with POST https://onlinewebdirectory.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_origin" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
